# UI Vault

> A personal, frontend-only catalog of UI components from free, vendorable sources
> (open-source animated React libraries and component registries), organized into one
> categorized, searchable library. Every entry ships free code with its source, license,
> install command and — where vendored — a live React preview. No backend: the catalog itself
> lives in TypeScript files under src/data (586 entries, 12 sources, 23 categories).

## Sources

- [React Bits](https://reactbits.dev) — Open-source animated, interactive & fully customizable React components. (MIT, live-previewable, 25 cataloged)
- [Motion Primitives](https://motion-primitives.com) — UI kit to make beautiful, animated interfaces, faster. (MIT, live-previewable, 18 cataloged)
- [FancyComponents](https://fancycomponents.dev) — Make the web fun again. (MIT, live-previewable, 16 cataloged)
- [NumberFlow](https://number-flow.barvian.me) — Animated number component, for React, Vue, Svelte & vanilla. (MIT, live-previewable, 4 cataloged)
- [Watermelon UI](https://watermelon.sh) — 600+ free open-source components, 100+ animations, 230+ blocks. (Free, live-previewable, 12 cataloged)
- [Aceternity UI](https://ui.aceternity.com) — The React component library for beautiful landing pages. (Freemium, live-previewable, 15 cataloged)
- [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com) — The canonical copy-paste component collection you own outright. (MIT, live-previewable, 65 cataloged)
- [Magic UI](https://magicui.design) — UI library for design engineers. (MIT, live-previewable, 76 cataloged)
- [Animata](https://animata.design) — Move, scale, rotate and animate with real components. (MIT, live-previewable, 154 cataloged)
- [Animate UI](https://animate-ui.com) — Animated components for your next project. (Free, live-previewable, 154 cataloged)
- [Launch UI](https://www.launchuicomponents.com) — Open-source components for your next launch. (MIT, live-previewable, 16 cataloged)
- [Origin UI](https://coss.com/origin) — 600+ copy-paste components, 30 families — the deepest form catalog anywhere. (MIT, live-previewable, 31 cataloged)

## Categories

### Components
- `text-animation` Text & Typography (88) — Animated text reveals, scrambles, gradients and typographic effects.
- `backgrounds` Backgrounds (48) — Shader, gradient and generative backgrounds for heroes and panels.
- `3d-webgl` 3D & WebGL (4) — Globes, physics and Three.js scenes that drop into a page.
- `buttons` Buttons & Actions (41) — Buttons with borders, magnets and sparks — actions that feel alive.
- `cards` Cards & Bento (25) — Spotlight, tilt, bento and stacking card treatments.
- `navigation` Navigation (35) — Navbars, docks, sidebars, tabs, breadcrumbs and scroll progress.
- `forms` Forms & Inputs (57) — Inputs, selects, OTP, uploads, sliders, toggles and date pickers.
- `overlays` Overlays (57) — Dialogs, drawers, popovers, tooltips, toasts and command bars.
- `numbers` Numbers & Counters (12) — Animated numbers, tickers and odometers.
- `micro-interactions` Micro-interactions (91) — Cursor tricks, physics toys and small moments of delight.
- `feedback` Feedback & Status (26) — Spinners, progress, skeletons, empty states and notifications.
- `data-display` Data Display (33) — Tables, charts, stats, badges and avatars for showing data.
- `chat` Chat & AI (5) — Chat and AI conversation UI — bubbles, message streams, attachments.

### Blocks
- `hero` Hero Sections (8) — Above-the-fold sections that set the tone of a page.
- `features` Feature Sections (7) — Feature grids, bento layouts and product story sections.
- `pricing` Pricing (2) — Pricing tables, plan comparisons and checkout prompts.
- `testimonials` Testimonials & Social Proof (3) — Quotes, marquees, logos and proof sections.
- `cta` CTA Sections (3) — Big closing calls-to-action and conversion moments.
- `faq` FAQ (9) — Frequently-asked-question sections and accordion groups.
- `footers` Footers (2) — Multi-column footers, sitemaps and newsletter captures.
- `sections-misc` Other Sections (26) — Team, blog, contact, stats, onboarding and everything else.

### Templates
- `dashboards` Dashboards (3) — Complete admin and analytics app layouts.
- `auth` Login & Signup (1) — Auth screens, OTP flows and onboarding.

## Links

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete catalog in one file
- [Sources](llms/sources/): one page per source
- [Categories](llms/categories/): one page per category
- Generated by `npm run llms` from src/data — do not edit by hand.
